questions.q: Why did Rat load everyone up with belts, swords, pistols and other gear?
choices: He did not want to be blamed later for forgetting anything
Badger ordered him to
He planned to sell the weapons
He wanted to scare Toad

questions.q: In what order did Badger tell the animals to follow him?
choices: Mole first, Rat next, Toad last
Toad first, Rat next, Mole last
Rat first, Toad next, Mole last
All side by side
questions.evidence: Mole first, 'cos I'm very pleased with him; Rat next; Toad last.

questions.q: What happened when it was Toad's turn to swing into the hole in the river-bank?
choices: He slipped and fell into the water with a splash
He got stuck in the hole
He refused to go in
He dropped the lantern
questions.evidence: he managed to slip and fall into the water with a loud splash

questions.q: Why did Badger nearly shoot Toad in the tunnel?
choices: Toad rushed forward and knocked everyone over, and Badger thought they were attacked from behind
Toad tried to run back home
Toad began singing loudly
Badger mistook Toad for a weasel at the trap-door
questions.evidence: The Badger thought they were being attacked from behind

questions.q: Where did the secret passage come out inside Toad Hall?
choices: Under a trap-door into the butler's pantry
In the boat-house
Behind the kitchen fireplace
In Toad's bedroom
questions.evidence: the trap-door that led up into the butler's pantry

questions.q: When the Chief Weasel called Toad "GOOD Toad, MODEST Toad, HONEST Toad," what did he really mean?
choices: He was making fun of Toad
He truly admired Toad
He wanted Toad to come back
He was thanking Toad for the house

questions.q: What did the weasels and ferrets do when the four friends burst in?
choices: Fled in panic through the windows and up the chimney
Fought bravely and won
Surrendered and asked for supper
Hid in the secret passage
questions.evidence: they broke and fled with squeals of terror and dismay

questions.q: In the hall, "some dozen or so of the enemy" lay "prostrate" on the floor. What does "prostrate" mean?
choices: Lying flat on the ground
Running fast
Singing loudly
Standing at attention
questions.evidence: on the floor lay prostrate some dozen or so of the enemy

questions.q: What happened to the stoat-sentries outside, according to Mole?
choices: They fought with the fleeing weasels and most rolled into the river
They captured Mole
They marched in to help the weasels
They stayed at their posts all night
questions.evidence: till most of 'em rolled into the river

questions.q: What did Mole decide about giving the captured weasels a licking?
choices: He let them off, since they had had enough for one night, and gave them each a roll
He beat each one soundly
He locked them in the cellar
He handed them to the police
questions.evidence: they had had licking enough for one night

questions.q: How did Toad show he was a gentleman at supper after the battle?
choices: He put away his jealousy and thanked Mole warmly
He made a long speech about himself
He paid everyone a shilling
He served everyone first and ate nothing
questions.evidence: put all his jealousy from him

questions.q: What job did Badger give Toad the next morning?
choices: Writing the invitations to a celebration Banquet
Cleaning the banqueting-hall
Cooking the Banquet
Fixing the broken windows
questions.evidence: the invitations will have to be written and got off at once, and you've got to write 'em

questions.q: Why did Toad suddenly agree so happily to write the invitations?
choices: He planned to fill them with boasting and a program of his own speeches and songs
He loved writing letters
Badger promised him a reward
He wanted to stay away from the others
questions.evidence: A fine idea had occurred to him while he was talking.

choices: There would be no speeches and no songs from him
He could not attend
He must pay for everything himself
He must invite the weasels
questions.evidence: there are going to be no speeches and no songs

questions.q: Rat said he "confiscated" Toad's boastful invitations. What does "confiscated" mean?
choices: Took them away so they could not be used
Mailed them quickly
Read them aloud
Signed them

questions.q: What did Toad do alone in his bedroom just before the Banquet?
choices: Sang a boastful song to an audience of empty chairs
Wrote a letter to the gaoler's daughter
Packed to run away
Cried himself to sleep
questions.evidence: collected all the chairs in the room and arranged them in a semicircle

questions.q: How did Toad behave at the Banquet?
choices: Modestly, giving credit to his friends and refusing to make a speech
Loudly, singing songs all night
Rudely, ignoring his guests
Sadly, leaving early
questions.evidence: He was indeed an altered Toad!

questions.q: What did Toad send to the gaoler's daughter afterward?
choices: A gold chain and locket set with pearls, with a modest letter
A new canary
A motor-car
A basket of buttered toast
questions.evidence: a handsome gold chain and locket set with pearls

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The friends win back Toad Hall, and Toad learns to behave more modestly
Toad is sent back to prison
Rat sails away to the South
Mole returns to his old home
